children.title: Folder layout
children.notes:
```
UnixGamingHub/
├── Cargo.toml        workspace: lists the crates
├── crates/
│   ├── ugh-core/     library: sensors, profiles, settings (shared by all)
│   ├── ugh/          terminal program (ugh stats)
│   ├── ugh-watcher/  always-running background program
│   ├── ugh-admin/    admin part
│   └── ugh-gui/      window (tech still open)
├── overlay/          in-game overlay (maybe C++)
├── scripts/          bash: install, packaging
├── packaging/        deb, AUR, Flatpak files
├── tempmon/          old monitor, reference only
└── plan/             this plan
```
Folders get added when we reach them. Step 1 = Cargo.toml, ugh-core, ugh.
